messages:
sana: Hey team — heads up: saw duplicate external webhook deliveries from the onboarding sample app when we hit a 429 + token-rotate combo yesterday. Repro steps attached.
jordan: ugh. can you paste the minimal repro? is this the node sdk sample or go one?
sana: Node sample. Quick repro: 1) create session, 2) rotate token in separate thread, 3) send request while previous token refresh in flight -> got 429 then client retried and server accepted twice. Short logs:
```
POST /v1/generate  -> 429
sdk retry -> POST /v1/generate (with refreshed token) -> 200
server processed both requests (no idempotency key)
```
sana: We use `Idempotency-Key` header in the sample app but the SDK retry layer sometimes drops/rewrites it during the auth refresh flow.
mike: interesting — is the header mutated by our token refresh helper? I thought we clone headers but maybe we reconstruct the request losing the key.
jordan: quick check: Node SDK has `safeReplay` flag that will attach `X-RW-Idempotency` when caller sets it, but our sample uses `Idempotency-Key`. Not consistent across SDKs.
olga: that parity mismatch will definitely bite customers. We should standardize on one header and update sample apps + docs. Proposal: canonical header `x-redwood-idempotency` (lowercase) and SDKs should normalize incoming header names.
kevin: for short-term patch can we add a debounce/once-per-idempotency-key guard at the client retry layer? e.g., before issuing a retry, check an in-memory map of keys that had an outstanding request for N seconds.
mike: debounce map helps but won't cover multi-process setups or customers that rely on baked-in server-side idempotency. Should be opt-in. Also need to avoid memory leak (evict by ttl).
sana: suggested quick fix I'm going to try: 1) ensure token refresh preserves headers (fix in node sdk), 2) add small `retryGuard` that stores active idempotency keys for 3s and prevents concurrent retries from re-sending same key. If no idempotency key, fall back to normal retry.
jordan: also add telemetry event when retry suppressed so we can see if this helps. `devex-bot` can post a metric to #incidents if suppression rate > threshold.
kevin: long term: server should accept idempotency header (canonical name) and return `Idempotency-Cache` header with status (cached|new) so clients can make smarter decisions.
mike: agreed. roadmap item for 1.8. Also we need a test in sampleapp CI that simulates token rotation + 429 and asserts no duplicate side effects.
olga: I'll draft a tiny RFC for header parity + server response header. Sana, can you open a PR for the node sdk header-preserve fix + the retryGuard prototype? Keep it behind a feature flag `client_retry_guard`.
sana: will do. PR in a few hours. patch will include unit tests and an e2e script for the sample app.
jordan: thanks — if you want quick reviewers ping @mike @olga. Also add a short note to the SDK migration guide about header name change.
devex-bot: Reminder: create issue #INC-987 for duplicate webhook deliveries, link PRs and add to next sprint if ready. :bell:
kevin: one more ask — update the sampleapp README with a clear example of setting idempotency keys and a note about avoiding automatic replays on payment-like endpoints.
sana: good call. I'll include that in the PR. Thanks all :thumbsup:
